payload.posture: Read Exodus 34:18–23 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the renewed covenant calendar names Weeks with the firstfruits of wheat harvest beside Unleavened Bread, Ingathering, firstborn redemption, Sabbath, and appearance before God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
